title: Euler-Bernoulli cantilever (cubic Hermite beam) vs closed form
criteria_note: Thresholds are the ladder's own gate limits (transcribed from the `description` strings' numeric limits), each reproduced here with operator + numeric threshold so the verdict is recomputable from the artifact without re-running the solver.

gates.recomputation: independent, from the artifact's own raw levels/parameters
gates.agreement: numerically-zero: both values below the 1e-10 noise floor (abs diff 1.507e-11)

gates.quantity: least-squares slope of log(field L2 rel. error) vs log(h), elements 2..32 (must be >= 1.5)
gates.recomputation: independent, from the artifact's own raw levels/parameters

gates.reference: recovered clamp shear vs qL, relative error < 1e-8
gates.recomputation: independent, from the artifact's own raw levels/parameters
gates.agreement: numerically-zero: both values below the 1e-10 noise floor (abs diff 4.529e-11)

limitations: Slender Euler-Bernoulli regime only (L/h = 100): transverse shear and rotary inertia are not exercised, so this grades the Hermite element and its consistent load vector, not a thick-beam formulation.

Displacement/rotation are nodally exact for this element, so the tip-error gate is a codeword check (machine-precision level) rather than a convergence study; the resolution information lives in G1.field_order.
